alex: Trying to use the JS SDK in a Deno edge function and also testing in Bun. Hitting "Cannot find module 'node:crypto'" from our bundle and some TS issues about globalThis.crypto. Anyone else seen this stack in Deno/Bun?

caroline: Which package entry are you importing? We have multiple built outputs (cjs/node/edge). Deno will blow up if a node-only file sneaks in.

alex: Minimal repro:
```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('RW_KEY') });
await client.generate('hello');
```
In Deno: Error from dist/cjs/crypto-fallback.js -> Cannot find module "node:crypto". In Bun: no explicit error, but crypto.subtle calls fail silently.

sam: Typical root cause: bundler/resolver picked our CJS/node build. Quick local hacks:
- Deno import_map mapping `node:crypto` -> `https://deno.land/std/node/crypto.ts`
- Force ESM import using a direct URL to an ESM entry (if we published one)
But both are friction for users.

kevin: Bun's node: specifier support is incomplete; its global WebCrypto sometimes lacks the exact subtle API shape we expect. Also Bun fetch streams behave slightly different than browsers.

alex: I tried an import_map but my environment still loads dist/cjs/* because of `require()` references inside that build. Deno can't even parse the CJS file due to the node: import. We need package-side fixes.

caroline: Proposed package changes: ship a small ESM edge build that uses only web platform APIs (globalThis.crypto, fetch, AbortController) and avoid any node: imports. Then set package.json exports so ESM importers get the edge build by default.

sam: Example exports map to try:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs"
  }
}
```
This makes modern importers (Deno/Bun/ESM bundlers) pick the edge ESM. Also publish a `types` file that matches the ESM build.

kevin: Typing gotcha: even with ESM build Deno TS throws `Property 'subtle' does not exist on type 'typeof globalThis'` if their tsconfig doesn't include DOM libs. We should ship `.d.ts` that includes a small ambient declaration like `declare global { var crypto: Crypto; }` so consumers aren't forced to change tsconfig.

alex: Example TS error I saw: `TS2339: Property 'subtle' does not exist on type 'typeof globalThis'` at usage of `globalThis.crypto.subtle`. Can't expect every Deno user to enable extra libs.

caroline: Other runtime adaptors: streaming differences between environments. Implement tolerant runtime helpers:
```js
function normalizeResponseBody(body) {
  // prefer native web readable stream, but accept bun/node variants
  if (!body) return null;
  if (typeof body.getReader === 'function') return body; // web
  if (typeof body.on === 'function') return nodeStreamFrom(body);
  return body; // best-effort
}
```
That reduces environment-specific branching in main code paths.

sam: Also add a tiny runtime detection at init that picks crypto API:
```js
const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle || globalThis?.webcrypto?.subtle || nodeCryptoSubtleShim;
```
and log a friendly warning if we fall back.

kevin: CI: we should add lightweight smoke tests for Deno and Bun to catch regressions (import, simple generate, no node: imports). Put them behind a matrix so they run on PRs touching SDK builds.

caroline: For types: include a shipped `edge.d.ts` bundled with the edge build that contains ambient declarations needed for Deno/Bun users. Also ensure `package.json` `types`/`exports` point to the right `.d.ts` for the ESM entry.

alex: TL;DR imho we should:
1) Publish a distilled ESM/edge build with no node imports.
2) Add `exports` that prefer the edge ESM for import resolution.
3) Ship ambient `.d.ts` to declare `globalThis.crypto` and any small web types.
4) Add Deno/Bun smoke tests to CI.

caroline: Yep. Please open a draft PR and tag runtime/eng-sdk. We'll review the exports map + types. Also add a short README snippet about Deno/Bun usage and minimal import_map if needed.

ci-bot: Task created: `sdk/deno-bun-smoke` (blocked by PR). Checklist: add deno run smoke, bun run smoke, verify no node: imports in edge build.

alex: Thanks, will push a PR in a few hours with repro, failing stacktrace, and a tentative exports/types patch.
